scientific_integrity: Explicit all-n topological proof with a separately executable finite combinatorial check. General prior fixed-point and Euler results and the polygon-deletion result are credited; no independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The formula classifies the ordinary quotient of path real moment-angle surfaces by coordinate reversal, not other graphs, subgroups, or homotopy quotients. Tests at n=3,...,11 do not replace the uniform proof. Independent validation and exhaustive publication-priority review have not been performed.
title: Reversal quotients of real moment-angle surfaces of paths
